scope: Every substantive theorem, proof, bound, counterexample and qualification in U1, checked against J1 and P2; symbolic review only.
method: Independent manual symbolic derivation, matrix-order checks, dimensions/count checks, and exact analytic counterexample evaluation. Filesystem tools used solely for reading and recording review; no source programs, simulations, fits or original code rerun.

checks.reason: With fixed design and quadratic prior precision H-Jhat^T W Jhat, subtracting the two normal equations yields -H^-1 Jhat^T W d. The stated H domination is exactly what the CS bound needs. Query bias is explicitly defined as its linear projection, not nonlinear fit or truth error.
Weighted Cauchy-Schwarz followed by v^T Jhat^T W Jhat v <= v^T H v = c^T C c gives the displayed bound; componentwise |d|<=epsilon gives the weighted envelope norm.
Each row contraction is at most sum_i |v_i| M_i. Multiplication by W_kk epsilon_k and summation yields the stated homoscedastic and general diagonal expressions.
Apply scalar Cauchy-Schwarz with nonnegative weights W_kk epsilon_k to row contractions. This yields exactly sqrt(v^T K_W v) sqrt(sum W_kk epsilon_k). The zero-envelope case is handled separately.

All three upper bounds apply to each component projection. Triangle inequality permits summing their minima without independence. Taking the minimum with the total-envelope bound remains valid; no unjustified ordering of the two constructions is asserted.

For fixed e_kl, expanding the linear and quadratic envelope sums proves gamma^T s and gamma^T T gamma. Query-dependent envelopes require additional finite features or regeneration. Scalar counts L and L(L+1)/2 are correct.

Expanding epsilon proves K=sum gamma_l K_l; each symmetric p by p K_l has p(p+1)/2 entries. Substituting Jhat_k=f_k^T B gives B^T S_l B exactly and the stated L m(m+1)/2 scalar count. Past online-fit Jacobians do not generally equal final-query Jacobians.

Expanding (J+E)^T W(r+e)-J^T W r gives all three terms. For r=(theta,1), e=(0,a theta), direct cost has minimizer zero and candidate derivative is (1+a^2)theta+a, yielding -a/(1+a^2). At zero only E^T r=a survives.
The derivative is the derivative at alpha=0 of the r+alpha e stationary branch under J1 hypotheses: derivative of score in alpha is J^T W e+E^T W r. It is not the finite-alpha displacement.

Whitening Phat=P+Delta P yields I+A with eigenvalues in [1-eta,1+eta]. Congruence and positive-matrix inversion prove both displayed Loewner bounds. Requires P positive definite, implicit in P^-1/2 and inherited from P2.
With J=0 and constant E rows a, P=lambda and Delta P=n a^2, so whitened defect is n a^2/lambda. Fixed per-record derivative error alone cannot yield a duration-uniform relative precision bound.

Four plug-in marginal SDs do not provide deterministic joint support or physical coverage. Requiring separately justified joint support or a verified self-consistent enclosure correctly avoids circular certification.

The norm condition implies H_exact >= (1-omega)P0. Integrating along a segment proves strict convexity for distinct points in the convex box. omega<1/2 is sufficient and acknowledged stronger than needed; GN alone does not supply the exact-Hessian premise.

Strict convexity implies at most one stationary point. Compactness and continuity give a constrained minimum. Strict lower-face negative and upper-face positive gradient signs give a feasible descent direction at every boundary point of a nondegenerate box, forcing the minimizer into the interior. The signs are extra hypotheses, not inferred from curvature.

P2 integrates the candidate exact Hessian between certified stationary fits and bounds the resulting inverse in P0 coordinates; U1 preserves the full-score and connecting-segment premises and does not substitute GN curvature.

Mean transport error and fit movement are distinct from covariance. Packet correctly withholds physical confidence-interval claims absent noise/prior law, coverage analysis, conditioning events, and other errors.

For a correct fixed Gaussian mean the whitened residual norm is chi-square n. Projection after an unregularized fixed full-rank linear fit has rank n-p and chi-square n-p. Other fit/noise assumptions require other laws; unexcited alternatives cannot universally be detected.

Union bound needs no independence. Constant per-check tail probability alone cannot establish an indefinite familywise guarantee; summable allocations or a valid sequential construction are sufficient approaches.

A bounded response envelope and bounded number of statistics do not bound accumulated score, precision, numerical error, or counters. Coherent defects are not independent fresh noise. Aging remains conditional on a joint evolution law; no lifetime or hardware certificate is inferred.

limits: Review accepts stated conditional mathematics only, not candidate feasibility, numerical allowances, empirical coverage, full SRAM, or lifetime performance.
Frozen-design exactness requires H to be the fixed-design objective Hessian including its unchanged quadratic prior; arbitrary exact nonlinear Hessians are not covered.
Weighted moments for general diagonal W require the corresponding observation weights; section 2 unweighted moments implement the stated homoscedastic formulas.
No manuscript edits made and no validation code was executed.
